title: Choosing a University Major
paragraphs: Faris loved literature, but his family expected him to study engineering. During his final year of high school, choosing a major felt very difficult.
He spoke honestly with his father. His father shared that he had once wanted to study history but had felt pressure to choose engineering instead.
The conversation gave Faris courage to choose literature. Some relatives needed time to understand his decision, but his father supported him.
Years later, Faris worked as a published writer. He often remembered that one honest conversation had helped him choose his own path.
